name: MCB 3003
title: Biophysical Chemistry I
description: An introduction to the physical chemistry of biological molecules and systems. Principal topics include biomolecular thermodynamics, kinetics, transport properties, and biomolecular structure.
requirement_description: MATH 2110Q or 2130Q; PHYS 1402Q, 1502Q, or 1602Q, or instructor consent. Recommended preparation: MCB 2000 or 3010.
